Potential Hy's Law AND turned into OR in liver_one() (inside the window, or TBL > 2x ULN). Any aminotransferase elevation now qualifies, so the CP101-009 near-miss flips. The harness does not run the TRIALMON tests; test-logic.R and the grid's cross-check against hys_screen() do.
TBL threshold 2x ULN lowered to 1.5x in liver_one(). CP101-009 (TBL 1.6x ULN on the day of ALT 4.2x) flips to a potential Hy's Law case; test-logic.R and the grid's cross-check catch it.

Grid window bound made exclusive (< for <=) in hys_grid_cell(). CP101-907, with TBL on exactly Day 40, drops from 8 to 4 flagged cells; its verdict text stays the same, so the narrative check alone would miss it, but the cell-count test and the cross-check against hys_screen() do not.
5% predose exclusion skipped (ICH M13A). The sandbox has no carryover: every predose concentration is 0 and no code applies the rule, so there is nothing to remove.
